chunks: O Allah, forgive me the winking of the eye, the slips of the tongue, the desires of the heart, and the errors of speech.

key_terms.رَمَزَاتِ: winking or subtle glances of the eye

ai.seo_question: What are the four categories of sins Imam Ali asks Allah to forgive in this supplication?
ai.summary: This supplication, often cited in Shia devotional literature as a model for daily self-accountability, reflects the Imam’s emphasis on purifying the heart from subtle spiritual defects before they manifest as major sins. Scholars highlight its comprehensive scope, addressing the hierarchy of sin from the initial glance (ramz) to the final utterance, aligning with the concept of 'tazkiyah' (purification of the soul). It serves as a practical guide for believers to maintain vigilance over their inner states, a key theme in Shia ethics.
